definitions.prediction: Ridge alpha=0.01, fit_intercept=False; fit A/P=4887 pairs; dev A=1194. R2=1-SSE/sum((y-y.mean())**2). No extra trace feature standardization.
definitions.paired_correction: The APF0 correction is a different fit. A scalar node-calibration intercept cancels from pair differences.
definitions.direct_patch: 0.0786 compares IE directly with TE using 1-sum((TE-IE)**2)/sum((TE-mean(TE))**2). There is NO fitted IE-to-TE regression and NO intercept. RMS ratio=RMS(IE)/RMS(TE).
definitions.intervention: One-way left-to-right patch at decision position. A trace predictive association and a direct patch effect are different quantities.
